# Spreadsheet String To Array

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

With string = "3\t\t2\r\n", format = "%.;%d", delimiter = "\t", array_type = 0 x 0 array, Run displays array = 1 x 3 array.

## What this example demonstrates

With string = "3\t\t2\r\n", format = "%.;%d", delimiter = "\t", array_type = 0 x 0 array, Run displays array = 1 x 3 array.
